text:
Situation: Spironolactone 100 mg tablets are low at Corvale East with 8.5 days on hand (106 tablets). Corvale General holds 27 days (375 tablets). Both sites' 100 mg product carries NDC 70518372103 labeled by REMEDYREPACK INC. with SPL set ID 7646ca22-710e-4a5c-9613-b829e2f9d5ce. Corvale Lakeside has only 25 mg tablets (10 days). The drug is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21. FDA status shows "To Be Discontinued since -" with no date provided.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include spironolactone as of 2026-10-21. The product label identifies OXFORD PHARMS as the manufacturing plant for the SPL set in use at both Corvale East and Corvale General.

Our position: We have sufficient total system inventory to cover near-term needs through an internal transfer. No shortage is declared by FDA. Purchasing from alternate manufacturers is possible but not required today.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 69 tablets of spironolactone 100 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Monitor daily usage and inventory at all three sites — requires pharmacy buyer to report weekly to the committee.
3. Reassess need for external purchase if Corvale General falls below 14 days on hand — requires pharmacy director and buyer joint review.

Not recommended: Initiating purchases from Accord Healthcare Inc., Advagen Pharma Ltd., Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, or Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC at this time.
